body:
Terminology correction "HTTP header" vs "HTTP header field"

Spec: https://httpwg.org/specs/rfc9110.html#rfc.section.5

Based on spec, HTTP header means entire message header section. Mostly in ASVS requirements "HTTP header" is with the meaning "HTTP header field".

labels.name: _5.0 - prep
labels.description: This needs to be addressed to prepare 5.0

title: Terminology correction "HTTP header" vs "HTTP header field"
